args.title: Corvid Packaging — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
- Corvid Packaging’s latest newsletter highlights its “Warehouse automation in 2026” coverage and points readers to the main article plus a free companion piece.
- The main article reports that autonomous carts increased pick rates by 18%, although integration took twice as long as planned.
- The companion piece says the biggest cost saving came from reducing warehouse mis-picks.
